engineeringSkip.reason: Claiming to extract net energy from the quantum vacuum via Casimir-force 'pressure differentials' violates the laws of thermodynamics and has no basis in known physics.

factCheck.reason: The quantum vacuum's zero-point energy is the lowest-energy state of space and cannot be tapped as a fuel — extracting net energy from it would violate thermodynamics, and no such lattice has ever produced power.
